news.headline: Iceland votes in knife-edge referendum on restarting EU accession talks
news.body: Icelanders went to the polls on 29 August 2026 to decide whether to resume EU membership negotiations, with polls showing a razor-thin contest. Early results were expected on 30 August, and a 'yes' would reopen talks without committing Iceland to immediate membership.

footerNote: All times converted from official kickoffs
